title: Vibration — ISO Zone D — Machine Stop
description: Vibration RMS exceeds ISO 10816-3 Zone D limit (11.2 mm/s). X={val}, Y={val2}, Z={val3} mm/s. Crest factor P063={val4}. Kurtosis P064={val5}. Machine stopped.
probable_cause: Catastrophic bearing failure, tool breakage, workpiece ejection, or structure loosening.
diagnostic_steps: Do not restart until vibration source identified
remedy: Identify and repair vibration source before restart. Full machine inspection required.
required_action: Immediate machine stop. Do not restart without authorised technician inspection.
escalation_path: If VIB-CR-001 is not addressed (immediate machine stop. do not restart without authorised technician inspection.), the fault will escalate in this order: SPN-CR-001, then AXS-CR-001, then VIB-MJ-001. Each subsequent code represents a more severe fault state requiring more urgent intervention. Query each related code for its specific thresholds and required actions.
